partners.mechanism_chain: SPAST (HGNC:11072) —DISRUPTS→ microtubule dynamics and neuronal development (GO:0007409); TUBA1C (HGNC:12004) —DISRUPTS→ cytoskeletal organization (GO:0007010); microtubule dynamics and neuronal development (GO:0007409) —LEADS_TO→ Hereditary spastic paraplegia (HP:0001277); cytoskeletal organization (GO:0007010) —DISRUPTS→ cell division and chromosome segregation (GO:0007049); cell division and chromosome segregation (GO:0007049) —LEADS_TO→ Oocyte/zygote/embryo maturation arrest (HP:0030049); microtubule dynamics and neuronal development (GO:0007409) —BINDS→ cell division and chromosome segregation (GO:0007049).
